description: Finds auspicious dates (muhurat) for marriage, griha pravesh (house warming), buying a vehicle or starting a business in a date range, using VedicDost's software and the classical rules of nakshatra, tithi and weekday. Use for "shubh muhurat for marriage in 2027", "griha pravesh dates next month".
